resources.string: The Remote Viewer
The Remote Viewer
This install is the phone itself. It is not a website in a window. It does not use an outside identity service.
Install tutorial
Keep the passphrase and the seed off this phone. This phone unlocks with its own screen lock. It does not hold a seed or a passphrase. There is no backup location in this install.
Free: this device\'s own lock plus the bare TRV layer. That does not require a purchase.
TRV Token🍃 is a simulation only. It buys exclusive in-app customizations only. It is not money, not crypto, and not redeemable for cash. The amount is not set.
The only telemetry in this install is this phone\'s own GPS, and only when you ask. The fix stays on this phone. There is no analytics, no ad network, and no other location service.

The full MiMo-V2.6-Pro weights do not run on this phone. MiniMind Max2 weights are not in this install and do not run. The weight file that ships is MiniMind2-Small. Nothing is sent off this phone. No paid host is used.

string-array.name: install_tutorial
string-array.item: This install is native. It is not a website in a window. It does not use an outside identity service.
The on-device weights that ship in this repo are MiniMind2-Small from jingyaogong/MiniMind2-Small. The license is Apache-2.0. The weight file is model.safetensors. A fit check is not a run.
MiMo-V2.6-Pro weights are not in this repo and do not run. MiniMind Max2 weights are not in this repo and do not run.
GrapheneOS is extra security. It is not required.
The phone package is a sideload. It can be installed on a Pixel 7, a Pixel 6a, other Pixels, and other phones that carry a signal. It is not a release-signed build. The signing key is not available.
